name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump’s Deal With Russia Inflames Ukraine War He Vowed to End
changes.summary: The Ukrainian president’s defiant decision to continue attacking Russian refineries underscores President Trump’s inability to end a war he had promised to resolve.

changes.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries as relations with Trump sour
changes.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over amid deepening tensions with Washington.

changes.title: Ukraine resumes strikes on energy targets, saying Russia never stopped its attacks
changes.summary: The tense alliance between Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and President Trump is nearing a new low point. After days of bitter back-and-forth between the two leaders, Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian energy targets. Trump had demanded an "energy ceasefire" this past Sunday between the two. Russia never stopped its.

changes.title: Why Russia Sees a Window to Bomb Ukraine Into Submission This Winter
changes.summary: Moscow is not winning on the battlefield. Instead, it is seizing an opening to inflict immense human suffering in Ukrainian cities.

changes.title: Why Trump’s Russian Diesel Deal Is Unlikely to Lower Fuel Costs
changes.summary: President Trump’s deal with Russia will probably not lower diesel prices that have soared because of his war with Iran and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries.

changes.title: Ukraine’s Exposure Grows as Satellite Use Is Restricted and Russia Escalates
changes.summary: A huge attack cut power to 600,000 people in Kyiv, and a Pentagon-funded satellite internet program appeared to be curbed without warning.

changes.title: ‘Republican wave’ unlikely but House GOP can ‘hold their own,’ says outgoing congressman
changes.summary: Retiring Rep. Dusty Johnson (R-S.D.) joins Meet the Press NOW to share his confidence in Republicans holding onto Congress in the midterms and his distaste for President Trump’s diesel deal with Russia.

changes.title: Senators Urge Trump to Reverse Diesel Deal With Putin
changes.summary: A bipartisan group of 12 senators called on the president to drop his decision to ease sanctions on Russia’s exports of diesel fuel, saying the deal would help Moscow continue the war in Ukraine.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump will headline a rally in Alaska Tuesday, federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home Monday, Trump's diesel deal with Russia frustrates European leaders.
